# cycle_provider_locations (Data Source)

Lists locations available from a Cycle provider integration. Use this to choose a `location_id` for `cycle_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List locations advertised by a provider integration.
data "cycle_provider_locations" "equinix" {
  integration_id = var.provider_integration_id
}

output "compatible_location_ids" {
  value = [
    for loc in data.cycle_provider_locations.equinix.locations : loc.id
    if loc.compatible
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) The provider integration ID to list locations for.

### Read-Only

- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations advertised by the provider integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `abbreviation` (String) A short abbreviation for the location.
- `availability_zones` (List of String) Availability zones at this location, if the provider reports them.
- `compatible` (Boolean) Whether Cycle currently supports this location.
- `id` (String) The location ID.
- `name` (String) The location name.
- `provider_code` (String) The location code returned by the provider.
- `provider_location` (String) The location name returned by the provider.
